decisive_spans.text: PET-CT scan: Showed significantly increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium

response.rationale: The PET-CT finding of increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium directly supports Pericardial Disease. While Constrictive Pericarditis is a type of pericardial disease, the PET-CT finding is more general and directly points to pericardial involvement, making D2 a slightly better fit given the available information.
